items.name: menu-forest-war-march
items.prompt: A war march through an ancient enchanted forest: proud, determined, a little mysterious. Steady deep war drums and frame drums, a driving low string ostinato, a noble French horn melody answered by a wooden flute, harp glints and a wordless choir rising at the swell. Moderate march tempo, D minor. A 30-second instrumental piece for a fantasy real-time strategy game's main menu, made to loop: its last bars lead back into its opening so the restart is seamless. Live orchestral and acoustic instruments only: no drum kit, no synth leads, no electronic or modern pop sound, no sung words.
items.title: Forest war march

Fast tempo, C minor, cinematic fantasy orchestra. A 30-second instrumental piece for a fantasy real-time strategy game's main menu, made to loop: its last bars lead back into its opening so the restart is seamless. Live orchestral and acoustic instruments only: no drum kit, no synth leads, no electronic or modern pop sound, no sung words.
items.title: Gathering of the broods

items.name: menu-woodland-battle-hymn

Moderate driving tempo, E minor, fantasy orchestra with folk colour. A 30-second instrumental piece for a fantasy real-time strategy game's main menu, made to loop: its last bars lead back into its opening so the restart is seamless.
